race.name: Kostarian Macaque
entries: Kostarian Macaques are small primates native to the rainforests of Kostaria.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Size
entries: Your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

entries.name: Climber
entries: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Fury of the Small
entries: When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

entries.name: Nimble Escape
entries: You can take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} or {@action Hide|XPHB} action as a Bonus Action on each of your turns.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can understand Common and Monkey.

language.name: Monkey
entries: A language of calls, vocalisations, gesture, and body language used by Kostarian Macaques.

entries.name: Arcane Translator
entries: A wizard you served grew tired of repeatedly casting magic merely to hold a conversation with you and granted you a permanent arcane means of translation.

You can understand, read, and write Common, but you cannot physically speak it. When you make deliberate vocalisations, you can choose creatures within 30 feet of you that can hear you and understand Common. Those creatures mentally perceive the meaning of your vocalisations in Common.

subclassFeature.name: Swordbound Spells
entries: You always have certain spells prepared when you reach particular Warlock levels, as shown in the Swordbound Spells table. These spells count as Warlock spells for you, but they don't count against the number of Warlock spells you prepare.

subclassFeature.name: Keeper of the Blade
entries: You gain proficiency with Medium Armor and Shields. You also gain the Weapon Mastery property of one weapon of your choice.

subclassFeature.name: Lingering Malice
entries: As a Bonus Action, choose one creature you can see. That creature is cursed by you for 1 minute. The curse ends early if either you or the target dies. You can use this feature twice, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
While a creature is cursed by this feature, you gain the following benefits:

items: {@b Improved Critical.} Your attack rolls against the cursed creature score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.
{@b Maim.} You gain a bonus to damage rolls against the cursed creature equal to 2 + half your Warlock level (round down).
{@b Reaper.} When the cursed creature dies, you can either transfer the curse to another creature you can see or regain Hit Points equal to half your Warlock level + your Charisma modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Swordbound Specter
entries: When a creature cursed by your Lingering Malice dies, you can bind its departing spirit to your service, causing a {@creature Swordbound Specter|AppliedHeroics} to rise from its corpse. The specter acts immediately after your turn and obeys your verbal commands.

The specter gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half your Warlock level. It gains a bonus to its attack rolls equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +0). It remains in your service until you finish a Long Rest, at which point it vanishes.

subclassFeature.name: Swordbound Parry
entries: When a creature cursed by your Lingering Malice hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to roll {@dice 1d6}. On a roll of 4 or higher, the attack misses you instead, regardless of its roll.

subclassFeature.name: Relentless Curse
entries: A creature cursed by your Lingering Malice has its Speed reduced by 15 feet.
As a Bonus Action, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of a creature cursed by your Lingering Malice.
